subject: Nimble Health: deletion orchestration for prompts/outputs/logs
messages:
From: Alex Patterson <alex.patterson@nimblehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Data removal request: prompts/outputs/logs for nimble-prod

Hi Soojin,

We need to initiate a removal of model prompts, generated outputs, and associated request logs tied to our nimble-prod tenant scope. Scope and asks below: 

- Time window: all records from 2025-11-01 through 2026-10-01 (inclusive).
- Data classes: user-provided prompts, model-generated outputs, inference logs (request/response bodies, metadata), and any cached KV entries derived from customer content.
- Evidence: a confirmation letter and an ops manifest showing which stores/keys were deleted and timestamps for each step.
- Desired completion: within two weeks if possible.

We are attaching the formal PO and a legal approval note (see attachment stub: nimble-approval-legal.pdf). Please advise on your execution workflow, SLA for completion, and whether partial redaction (retain anonymized audit logs) is available.

Thanks,
Alex Patterson
Director of Product Compliance
Nimble Health

Attachment: nimble-approval-legal.pdf (PDF, 240 KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Patterson <alex.patterson@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Data removal request: prompts/outputs/logs for nimble-prod

Alex — thanks for the clear breakdown and the legal approval. We can absolutely run this. High level plan and next steps below so procurement/legal and your security team have a single source of truth: 

1) Intake & verification (48h): we will confirm tenant IDs, API keys, and the account owner to scope which clusters and KV namespaces to target.
2) Pre-delete evidence snapshot (1 business day): generate read-only export of indexes and a tamper-evident manifest.
3) Execution window (24–72h): run deterministic purge jobs across logs, storage, and KV; one-pass deletes with epoch timestamps.
4) Post-delete validation (24h): run queries to confirm absence; produce ops-execution-log and deletion manifest.
5) Delivery: signed confirmation letter + attachments.

Questions for you (please reply inline):
- Confirm tenant name/ID and the exact API keys to exclude from scope (if any).
- Are you requesting full cryptographic zeroization of keys, or is logical deletion across our services acceptable?
- Do you want us to retain anonymized audit logs (yes/no)?

CC'ing Marcus (ops lead) to propose the detailed runbook and Hannah on security sign-off. I'll open an internal ticket once we get your confirmation.

— Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Patterson <alex.patterson@nimblehealth.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Data removal request: prompts/outputs/logs for nimble-prod -- ops plan

Alex / Soojin — I'm Marcus from Ops. Below is the concrete orchestration we'll run once you confirm scope. I'm also attaching the internal ops checklist as a PDF stub (nimble-erase-ticket-87321.pdf).

Execution runbook (high level):
- Step 0: Create irreversible ticket in our ops system (TICKET-87321). Snapshot permissions and store location.
- Step 1: Export manifest of affected indices (S3 paths, KV namespaces, ES indices) and compute checksums. Save manifest in WORM bucket for audit (read-only until deletion).
- Step 2: Freeze ingestion and route new requests for nimble-prod to a short-term denylist to avoid re-ingestion during the run.
- Step 3: Run deterministic deletion flows:
   * KV namespace purge (prefix-based, TTL enforcement removal)
   * Object storage delete with multi-part removal and object lock disable (where applicable)
   * Tracing/logs truncation and retention policy override for the target dates
- Step 4: Post-delete verification queries and sampling across replicas to ensure no remaining PII-labeled artifacts.
- Step 5: Produce ops-execution-log-YYYYMMDD.txt and deletion-evidence-manifest.json, then redact small internal-only fields.

Estimated timeline: 48–72 hours from approval + business-day constraints for WORM manifest handling. We will not perform cryptographic key zeroization automatically; if you require HSM/KMS key destruction for exported snapshots we need explicit authorization and a separate ticket.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: trailing cached KV entries on edge nodes. Mitigation: coordinate a cache flush during the window and provide a short TTL bump prior to deletion.
- Risk: partial retention by downstream analytics (exported datasets). Mitigation: include downstream owners in the MAA and request their deletion confirmations.

Please reply with: APPROVE to proceed with the runbook as-is, or APPROVE+KMS to include key-zeroization.

Attachment: nimble-erase-ticket-87321.pdf (ops checklist)

A couple of clarifications:
- Please exclude the test-nimble sandbox namespace (tenant ID nimble-sbx) from the purge.
- We want anonymized audit logs retained for 1 year; please redact PII but keep event-level metadata for our audit team.

Please proceed and share the ticket number and ETA.

Best,
Alex

- Completion: 2026-10-18T16:03:17-07:00 (all targeted stores processed)
- Scope: nimble-prod (explicitly excluded nimble-sbx), date range 2025-11-01 — 2026-10-01
- Actions performed: KV prefix purge (namespaces: nimble-kv-main), S3 object removal (paths listed in manifest), logs truncation/retention override, cache flush across 3 edge regions.
- Evidence delivered: ops-execution-log-20261018.txt (attached), deletion-evidence-manifest.json (attached), signed confirmation letter PDF (confirmation-letter-nimble-20261018.pdf).

Important notes:

- Any downstream datasets that previously pulled data from nimble-prod must confirm their own deletions — we included a list of known consumers in the manifest.
- If you require cryptographic zeroization for exported snapshots, file a separate request referencing TICKET-87321 and we will escalate to KMS ops.

Attachments (stubs): ops-execution-log-20261018.txt (4.2 MB), deletion-evidence-manifest.json (18 KB), confirmation-letter-nimble-20261018.pdf (23 KB)

Let us know if you'd like a short readout call; otherwise we'll close the ticket after 7 business days unless we hear otherwise.
